In November 1873, a party of 21 prospectors left Salt Lake City and headed towards the mountains. Two months later, they arrived at the Ute Indian encampment where they were urged to wait out the winter. After two weeks, 6 men including 23-year old Alferd Packer who acted as their guide, decided to try to make it to an Indian agency 75 miles away. 65 days later, only Alferd Packer arrived at the agency. Over a year later the remains of the missing men were found and by now Packer had told two different versions of what had happened. Whether he murdered them all or claimed to have killed only one in self-defense, what he never denied was that he ate one of the men. Since there was no law on the Colorado books for cannibalism, Packer was arrested for first-degree murder. Due to legal technicalities, it would take two trials to convict Packer (of 5 counts of manslaughter) and sentence him to 40 years in prison. In July of 1989, law and forensic Professor James Starrs of George Washington University decided to try to prove which version of Packer’s tale was indeed the true one. He led a team including archaeologists and forensic anthropologists and unearthed the 5 graves. He hoped by studying the bones, the truth of how these men died would finally be revealed. The bones were taken to the anthropology lab at the University of Arizona where forensic anthropologist Dr. Walter Birkby and a small team studied them. With the evidence uncovered from the bones, Starrs concluded that Packer was a murdering cannibal and liar. On this episode of Skeleton Crew, Dr. Elizabeth Murray will re-examine the evidence and documentation taking a closer look at the most recent conclusions of the forensic anthropological studies to see which version of Alferd Packer's story may be closer to the truth.

Little Baby Bum is here to help you fall to sleep; with soothing, relaxing animated lullabies. These gentle and sensory videos are accompanied by lullaby versions of much loved nursery rhymes, helping to take you to the land of nod.

Get ready for a big day of discovery and play with Twinkle and her friends! The fun starts as they learn to play new musical instruments, with Twinkle on drums, Kitty on the sax and Bunny on guitar! Then, it's time to play a fun game of 'Twinkle Says'! Follow along as they give you playful instructions and see if you can keep up. The discoveries continue as the friends find a mirror and make funny faces and wonder what an umbrella is for before it starts to rain!

Join Twinkle for some gentle lessons and soothing bedtime songs. First, Twinkle learns about the importance of eating healthy, delicious fruit, like bananas, oranges and grapes. Then, help her find Sandy the Seagull while learning what sounds a pig, duck and cow make! After a long day of learning, it's time to get ready for bed. Listen as Twinkle and Mr. Moon sing a soothing nighttime lullaby to help you relax and drift off to sleep.

Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

Join Digley, Dazey and the crew for a big day of rescues and learning! When the barn at Old MacDonald's Farm catches fire, the crew uses quick thinking to extinguish the flames. Then, a trip to the mountains goes wrong when an avalanche traps them in a tunnel, and they must find a clever way to escape! The rescues continue as Digley faces his fear of heights to restore a broken clock and the friends work together to save Scout after she falls down a hole during a thunderstorm.

Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

Get ready to laugh as everything goes hilariously wrong for Kii and Yii and their friends! The chaos starts when Robot creates a jelly-making machine, but it goes haywire and he ends up stuck inside a giant wobbly jelly! Then, Princess Cat puts way too much soap in her washing machine, causing it to overflow and fill her entire castle with bubbles! From a wobbly tooth to a picky eater, it's one funny problem after another!

Join Kii and Yii for songs about feeling good and staying safe! First, learn the best way to get a healthy smile in a fun and educational song about how to brush your teeth properly. Then, learn how to be safe when you're riding a bike at the playground. The lessons continue as Kii and Yii sing about being kind to each other, especially when a friend is sick. From learning colors to singing a soothing lullaby, these songs will make you feel good!

Learn important lessons this month! Find out how to play safe at school, from not running in the classroom to being careful with scissors. Go on a school trip to a fire station and meet parents who are scientists, vets, and firefighters!

Play and learn at school this month! Get your face painted like your favorite animal and put on a puppet show. Build your own bus, play a funny face game, and discover the letters of the alphabet in an exciting game with Mom.

Join Baby John for a fun day at school! First, he learns that karate can be challenging, but with a lot of practice, he learns how to kick, punch and move! Then, he learns how to play soccer with the help of his big brother and sister. The day continues with a special surprise guest who drops in and teaches the gang how to play different instruments, like the piano, trumpet and guitar! It's always a fun day of learning at school!

What should Baby John be when he grows up? Join him as he explores different fun jobs! First, it's race day for Baby John and Manny! They each choose a vehicle to test on the racetrack: an ice cream truck against an ambulance! Then, it's superhero day at daycare, and Manny arrives in a luchador outfit. Everyone is curious, so he explains that luchadores are Mexican superheroes! The fun continues as Baby John drives a bus and picks up friends dressed in different professions.

Join Baby John on a big world adventure! First, he and his friends explore the reptile zoo to learn all about the scaly creatures. Then, it's time to learn about bugs at the insect park! The adventure gets out of this world as Jack, Jill and Baby John explore a new adventure: space camp! They learn how to be an astronaut and visit other planets as they fly a rocket ship and train in zero gravity!

Get ready for some bath and bedtime fun with Baby John! First, Baby John is a little scared to try swimming, but his family is there to show him just how easy and fun it can be! Then, it's time for a bath. Bathtime has never been so exciting, as Baby John has fun learning his colors by matching different colored bath sharks to their hoops. Finally, it's time to get ready for bed with a fun story and a cozy cuddle.

During a game of hide and seek Deedee and Nino come across a panicky Mewmew who cannot locate his key. Deedee creates a spell to get back all of Mewmew’s missing things and in come his key, including his long lost bubble-cordion and pocket fork. But Mewmew doesn’t want those things back as he had already replaced them. So Deedee offers to keep them as she couldn’t stand the sight of them being thrown away. On the way they find Charlie hiding from his lost but newly found alarm clock that is chasing him. The clock won’t let Charlie sleep a bit by ringing all the time, so Deedee offers to take it along with the rest. Deedee gets many more additions to her lost and found group as many more citizens of Abra-Dabra are affected with lost things. But as Deedee doesn’t have any space to store them, she puts up a give-away store. Now everyone’s happy.

Boris and Sandy are fighting over the water sprayer and drenching Uncle Charlie with it. This leaves Charlie with no choice but to call on Deedee’s magic. Deedee finds a spell to make friendship dust as the perfect solution. Whoever the dust falls on will be best friends with whoever they see first. Happy for getting the magic powder they all set off to see Boris and Sandy. But on the way the Doobydoos rush at them so suddenly that they fall all over them and the Doobydoos become friends of Charlie and carry him off. Nino tries to explain the situation to Deedee, but she is too busy to listen. Back over at Charlie’s, the Doobydoos are treating him as a king and tries to run away from his new friends. Deedee finds some of the missing magic powder but tries to find Charlie. Deedee tries to bring things back to normal with magic, but Nino is against it. They find a way to get the twins to work together and splash the Doobydoos with water and wash off the friendship dust. The twins are friends again even though Deedee’s magic didn’t work as expected.

p.t: Royal Documentaries - S01:E38 - HM The Queen A Remarkable Life
